data.note: Paladin is a half-caster (slots progress at half rate; first slot at L2 per the standard half-caster table). Prepared spells = CHA mod + half Paladin level (rounded up), min 1. v0 surfaces the casting ability; slot progression is computed in derive.ts (currently only full-caster progression is implemented — half-caster slot table is a follow-up).

activities.name: Lay on Hands (Pool)
activities.note: Pool of healing power equal to 5 x Paladin level. As a Bonus Action, touch a creature and draw from the pool to restore HP, OR spend 5 points to end one disease or one Poisoned condition. v0 surfaces the pool as a single resource; HP-vs-cure-pool spend distinction isn't enforced.

data.note: At L1 pick 2 weapons; gain access to their masteries. Swap one chosen weapon's mastery on each Long Rest. v0 surfaces the chosen-weapon flag; weapon-mastery effects (Cleave, Push, Slow, etc.) aren't simulated.

Choose one Fighting Style. Paladin's available styles in 2024 SRD 5.2: Blessed Warrior, Blind Fighting, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Interception, Protection. Defense/Dueling/Great Weapon Fighting/Blind Fighting/Interception/Protection rows live in features/fighter.json; Blessed Warrior is paladin-specific (below).

Learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice. They count as Paladin spells; CHA is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Paladin level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Cleric cantrip. v0 surfaces the choice; the cantrip slots live on character.spells.known.

When you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, expend a spell slot to deal extra Radiant damage: 2d8 for a 1st-level slot, +1d8 per slot level above 1st (max 5d8 from a 4th-level slot, capped). Once per turn. v0 doesn't consume the spell slot automatically and uses a placeholder magic identifier `divineSmiteSlotDice` for the bonus die total; surfaces as a toggle the player flips per-attack.

Paladin's 2024 Channel Divinity analogue. Subclass grants specific Channel Oath options at L3. v0 surfaces the resource as 1 use/short rest; later levels scale uses (2 at higher tiers in some printings; SRD 5.2 keeps a single resource recovered on Short or Long Rest).
Placeholder for Sacred Oath subclass selection (Oath of Devotion, Glory, Vengeance, Ancients in 2024). The chosen subclass slug lives on character.classes[].subclass.
Player chooses +2/+1 distribution or a feat. v0 surfaces the choice; the chosen ASI is applied via stat-modifiers on the character document at edit time.

activities.name: Find Steed (Faithful Steed)
activities.note: Cast Find Steed without expending a spell slot, once per Long Rest. You can also cast it using a Paladin spell slot normally. The Find Steed spell row should be added to character.spells.known when this feature is online.
